queries: free 3D game assets CC0 Kenney Poly Haven OpenGameArt Unity Unreal 2026

content.text:
Here are good places to get **free 3D game assets**:

| Site | Best for | License notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Kenney** | Low-poly packs, modular buildings, props, UI, game-ready sets | Mostly **CC0**, great for commercial games |
| **Poly Haven** | High-quality 3D models, HDRIs, textures/materials | **CC0**, free for any use ([polyhaven.com](https://polyhaven.com/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **OpenGameArt** | Mixed 2D/3D assets, music, sounds, textures | Varies: CC0, CC-BY, GPL, etc.—check each asset ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenGameArt.org?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Quaternius** | Stylized low-poly characters, monsters, environments | Usually very permissive/free; check pack page |
| **itch.io free game assets** | Indie asset packs, low-poly kits, voxel/PSX styles | Varies by creator |
| **Sketchfab** | Huge library of free models | Filter by **Downloadable** + license; avoid “Editorial”/non-commercial if selling |
| **Unity Asset Store – Free** | Unity-ready models, environments, VFX | License varies; check if allowed outside Unity |
| **Fab / Unreal Marketplace free assets** | Unreal-ready assets, materials, environments | Some assets may be Unreal-only; check license |
| **ambientCG** | PBR materials/textures | **CC0**, useful for 3D environments |
| **FreeGameAssets.com** | Curated game-ready 3D models | Many low-poly/engine-ready assets; check individual licenses ([freegameassets.com](https://www.freegameassets.com/category/3d-models?utm_source=openai)) |

**Best quick picks:**
- For **low-poly game prototypes**: **Kenney** or **Quaternius**
- For **realistic environments**: **Poly Haven** + **ambientCG**
- For **variety**: **OpenGameArt**, **itch.io**, **Sketchfab**
- For **commercial-safe assets**: prefer **CC0** assets

**Important:** Before using any free asset in a commercial game, check the license. Look for **CC0** if you want the safest “use however you want” option. CC-BY usually requires credit, and CC-BY-NC usually means **no commercial use**.
